scripts.rebuild: cd react && yarn reinstall && yarn build && yarn link && cd .. && cd example && yarn reinstall && yarn build && yarn start
scripts.build: cd react && yarn build && cd .. && cd example && yarn reinstall && yarn build && yarn start
scripts.dev: concurrently "yarn workspace @typeblox/react run watch" "yarn workspace example run start"
